result.quote: Therefore the LORD has delivered him to the lion, and it has mauled him and killed him
result.reason: The key is explicitly supported, but the broad wording permits another materially different answer: the prophet also said that the LORD delivered the man to the lion and that it killed him. The question should specify that it is asking what the man of God had done. The edit still preserves the source pair’s intended fact that he had disobeyed the LORD’s command.
